text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Have you two decided what you're goingto do
today?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Whyzzat? Is there somethinginteresting
going on?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I don't have any plans other thantraining.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Then, how about we throw a hot potparty?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I haven't quite decided what kind of hotpot
would be best, however...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well if that's the case, how about wetest our
mettle with a mystery hot pot?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, that sounds like fun too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A mystery hot pot... I've heard rumblingsabout it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's a dish where both the edible andinedible are
all mixed together...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: L-let's skip the inedible things, shall we?
